LanguageData.TF_UnknownTraitDesc: An unknown trait. It will reveal itself in time.
LanguageData.TF_MaterialTipDesc: Feels no pain, doesn't bleed or rot, and is immune to toxins. Butchering yields its material.
LanguageData.TF_Settings_LightsHint: Off: glowing creatures keep their look but light nothing up.
LanguageData.TF_Settings_LightFollowHint: How far a walking creature gets ahead of its light. Higher is cheaper with many glowing creatures; the light still recentres when it stops.
LanguageData.TF_Settings_EffectsHint: Embers, smoke and other effecters. Tints and glows always show.
LanguageData.TF_Settings_InheritHint: Multiplies each trait's own chance to pass to offspring.
LanguageData.TF_Settings_DiscoveryMessages: Message when a trait is discovered
LanguageData.TF_Settings_ArmorHint: Share of the stuff's armor value. Steel at this setting: +{0} sharp armor.
LanguageData.TF_Settings_DamageHint: How strongly the stuff's damage multipliers apply. 0%: every material hits like flesh.
LanguageData.TF_Settings_FireHint: How much flammability changes fire damage and ignition. At this setting: wood takes x{0} fire damage, stone x{1}.
LanguageData.TF_Settings_ButcherHint: A steel bear (body size 2.4) gives about {0} steel.
LanguageData.TF_Settings_PreciousHint: Extra units for small-volume stuffs like gold and silver, as vanilla does.
LanguageData.TF_Settings_MarketValueHint: A tamed jade bear counts its jade toward colony wealth (and raid size).
